name: cc-fuzzer
description: LLM-in-the-loop coverage-guided fuzzing for C/C++ with strict, schema-driven, deterministic state. v0.17 adds: (1) Multi-fuzzer campaigns — schema v8 supports an engine-agnostic per-slot model (fuzz-config/v2 fuzzer_slots[], fuzzers/v1 manifest); each slot has its own pid/log/engine files; check-slot-liveness.sh per-slot auto-restart with anti-flap. Single-fuzzer campaigns are unchanged (default "main" slot). (2) Seed-safety scanner (check-seed-safety.sh) rejects unambiguously destructive payloads (rm -rf /, fork bombs, mkfs on real devices, dd to block devices, etc) before they enter the corpus. (3) write-harness-built.sh wrapper computes real SHA-256 hashes for target_source_hash / build_command_hash, replacing the v0.15 placeholder-stub bug. (4) migrate-state.sh v7->v8 tombstones legacy findings/v1 records with malformed IDs to findings-legacy.jsonl. v0.16: Opus-based campaign-planner + /cc-fuzzer:plan + /cc-fuzzer:delta + blame-finding.sh. v0.15: process-based fuzzing, two-stage triage, /cc-fuzzer:report. Architecture inspired by OSS-CRS, Buttercup, OSS-Fuzz-Gen, and Atlantis-Multilang.
